substance.statement: Explains render_brief in streams/lib/stream.sh: substitutes {RUN} and {STREAM} with sed, writes with printf '%s' so there is no trailing newline, and prints the path.
Explains lane_run_brief: send, then wait-idle with a default 45-minute timeout, then transcript saved under runs/.
States the lane.sh send guard: a prompt file outside the streams directory is refused, quoting 'refused: prompt must live under'.
Describes hash_cfg (sha256 of ~/.claude.json and ~/.codex/config.toml, first 16 characters) compared before and after start or create, and that a change prints host_config_changed and exits 3.
States what wait-idle does when the session status is waiting and what exit code a timeout returns (4).
